mentions.note: Belgrave member; first of 51 in Metropolitan Police v Stock Exchange 14¼ miles walk, walking for the Police; 6th in Railways A.A. v Metropolitan Police match at Brighton
2nd; report hopes he will be chosen for the Olympics; (P) as printed: walked for the Metropolitan Police W.C. team, which the report says consisted, with one exception, of Belgrave members

share.d: Fred Rickards (Metropolitan Police) in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1929–1936: 2 mentions in 2 issues and 2 race results.
